title: First Time Indie Dev - 2 Weeks In
author: Zamaxan1
selftext:
Hey all!

Just wanted to share my experience.

A couple weeks ago I finally decided I was going to sit down and try to develop a game in Unity.

I have been able to compliment EVERY ASPECT with AI. 

Coding struggles? - Codex

Imaging? ChatGPT

Audio? SUNO

Models? MESHY

Voiceover? ElevenLabs 

To anyone who thinks it tAkEs tHe lIfE oUt oF iT, you couldn’t be more wrong.

It has allowed me, someone with 0 developmental skill for game development, to create a fully functional, First Person Medieval Low Fantasy RogueLite,  in 2 weeks with a fantastic foundation and a fantastic amount of progress.

I can focus on the creative big picture aspects of the project. “Oh man a huge medieval lantern would look great here!” MESHY -> Model/Texture -> Unity” 

“Oh I’d love to implement a mechanic that does XYZ” done in minutes, not hours or days.

Oh I’d love to add a candle flicker effect on it too. -> codex -> design a script for a candle flicker effect on a point light for a lantern”

The list goes on. I’m able to brain storm gaming ideas and IMMEDIATELY take action to complete them. No having to scour the internet for some resource free BS that sounds/looks mediocre.

It is allowing me to make weeks of progress in HOURS. I would never have been able to get over this hurdle alone. Dad with 2 young kids, working full time. I can sit down for an hour after work and get meaningful progress on the project instead of barely anything, which would be a huge motivation killer. 

I’m beyond impressed with all of the utility AI has allowed me to do, and I’m pretty damn sure no one would know unless I told them.

Long story short, I LOVE AI. THE FUTURE IS NOW OLD MAN!

comments.author: Prior-Meeting1645
comments.body: In what ways is suno better than elevelabs haven’t heard of that one

replies.author: Zamaxan1
replies.body:
SUNO is more for music generation. I used it to generate 10 varieties of “main menu/exploration slower music” and 10 “battle/combat” tracks.

I used chatgpt to give me a prompt to describe the song I wanted to SUNO, copied and pasted that into the prompt, and it did amazing work. It can do instrumental and/or voiced tracks.

comments.author: Mechdudez
comments.body: I mean that can be your opinion, but people can still tell if AI was in the driver seat or not. Its cool you can do all this. I wouldn't be so quick to say "people are wrong" cause thats your customer base. So insulting the people that want to potentially buy your game is odd to me.

replies.author: Zamaxan1
replies.body:
They aren’t my customer base if they don’t like AI.  
They won’t buy it anyways by that logic. Lumping all gamers as people who don’t like AI is not accurate. 

I’m not making this for customers. I’m making it as a passion project for myself. The people who are unable to enjoy a product because AI played a part in its development will have to sit in a padded room in a decade because it’ll be everywhere. Sorry 🤷‍♂️
